info.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing a secure gateway to the invoice backend API. Exposes 100+ tools organized by domain (agents, invoices, customers, payments, etc.). All endpoints except /health require mTLS client certificate authentication.
info.title: CyperNova MCP Server
